abilities.name: Contradiction
abilities.narrationHints: You name the flaw in what someone is doing WHILE they are doing it, and the doing comes apart. Not a taunt — a demonstration. Spoken, precise, and only ever second.
abilities.description: Interrupt an action by naming its actual error out loud while it is happening — the plan with the gap, the boast with the hole, the ritual with the wrong step — and the move falters. The Syllogists' first offense, and the only one that cannot start a fight.

tree.name: Named Flaw
tree.grants: Interrupt an action or claim by naming its actual error out loud — the plan with the gap, the boast with the hole, the ritual with the wrong step. The move falters and must be reworked — the interruption hinders them for as long as the flaw stands unanswered.
tree.cannot: REACTIVE ONLY — nothing to contradict means nothing happens. The flaw must be REAL; inventing one is Falsecraft and this is not that. The unreasoning are immune.

tree.name: Reductio
tree.grants: Follow their position to where it collapses. A commitment they made becomes a thing they cannot act on — the oath that now forbids the blow, the doctrine that now forbids the door.
tree.cannot: They must have STATED the position; you cannot bind someone to a belief they never claimed. The shameless simply proceed anyway.
tree._gainNote: ⚠️ r2 turns their own commitment against them and holds while the commitment does — targets and conditions, not scale.

tree.name: Collapse

tree.cannot: You have made a permanent enemy of everyone whose ground you took, and the truth of it will not soften that. A structure with no flaw stands, and you look like a fool.

abilities.name: Carried Name
abilities.narrationHints: You hold a dead person's name the way a room holds a struck bell. Speak it and what they were comes back into the space — not a ghost, a WEIGHT. People remember correctly for as long as you hold it.
abilities.description: ⛔ YOU HOLD HOW A PERSON ACTUALLY IS, AND THE CRAFT PULLS THEM BACK TOWARD IT. Speak a name you carry and what has been done to them starts to come undone — the rewriting, the corruption, the thing wearing their face. ⚠️ THE MEMORY IS THE TEMPLATE, AND YOU CHOSE IT.
